scope: Source and bounded isolated verification; production read-only observations
priority_definition: P1 significant user constraint failure; P2 material defect/control gap; P3 lower-impact maintenance or defence-in-depth. These are not CVSS scores.

findings.title: Negated hard budget ceilings interpreted as floors
findings.reproduction: Parse a recipient budget expressed as no more than GBP20 or nothing over GBP20; validate a synthetic idea above that ceiling.
findings.baseline_result: The phrase could be treated as a minimum and admit an over-budget idea.
findings.impact: A stated maximum did not reliably constrain recommendations.
findings.remediation: Recognize negated ceilings before genuine floors and ranges; retain the lower real budget cap during product enrichment.
findings.verification: Positive and counterexample fixtures pass; existing approved baseline selection retained.
findings.limitation: Natural-language parsing and estimated prices are not verified retailer prices.

findings.title: Retailer enrichment discarded explicit recipient exclusions
findings.reproduction: Generate a non-leather journal concept for a leather-excluding recipient, then supply a matching leather retailer listing.
findings.baseline_result: Recognized exclusions were not retained in the retailer matching contract.
findings.impact: An apparently suitable concept could become an explicitly unwanted product.
findings.remediation: Carry bounded exclusions through normalized specs, enforce them before similarity, abstain for incomplete constraints, and bind new receipts to product specifications.
findings.verification: Excluded and malformed/overflow cases reject; normal and legacy-client cases pass.
findings.limitation: Unsigned and pre-upgrade receipts remain compatible; receipts are not mandatory authenticated product plans.

findings.title: Inline no clauses missed explicit exclusions
findings.reproduction: Put no leather inside an otherwise ordinary recipient sentence rather than in a separate exclusion field.
findings.baseline_result: The inline exclusion was omitted from parsed constraints.
findings.impact: Dislikes expressed in natural descriptions were inconsistently enforced.
findings.remediation: Share explicit exclusion parsing across recipient and commercial evaluation.
findings.verification: Reproduced inline forms and non-exclusion counterexamples pass.
findings.limitation: Not a comprehensive multilingual or allergen classifier.

findings.title: Variant matching lost size-system and short-unit identifiers
findings.reproduction: Request UK size 8 and offer a US 8 / UK 6 listing, or conflicting single-letter/unit variants.
findings.baseline_result: Short identifiers were removed, allowing incompatible variants to appear equivalent.
findings.impact: Wrong sizes or variants could be shown despite a known mismatch.
findings.remediation: Preserve system/unit identifiers and their relationships in hard variant checks.
findings.verification: Explicit conflicts reject and matching variants remain eligible.
findings.limitation: Incomplete retailer metadata still requires abstention; no universal variant ontology.

findings.title: Awin imported listings without proven new condition
findings.reproduction: Import rows marked used, refurbished, unknown, missing condition, or conflicting condition fields.
findings.baseline_result: Rows could be published as new despite contrary or absent evidence.
findings.impact: Future activation could expose misleading condition claims.
findings.remediation: Require explicit consistent new-condition evidence; abort an empty eligible import before publication, cleanup or D1 calls.
findings.verification: Final importer fixtures pass for all rejected classes and explicitly new items.
findings.limitation: Awin remains disabled; old imported generations require a validated refresh before activation.

findings.title: Awin advertiser allowlist widened through name aliases
findings.reproduction: Configure an explicit advertiser ID list and supply a different ID sharing an allowed merchant name.
findings.baseline_result: Name matching could admit an advertiser outside the explicit ID selection.
findings.impact: Operator-selected merchant scope was not an effective hard boundary.
findings.remediation: Apply aliases only when no explicit advertiser ID allowlist is supplied.
findings.verification: Explicit-ID negative and intended default-name cases pass.
findings.limitation: Account-level advertiser approval remains externally unverified.

findings.title: Valid Awin product IDs truncated by generic offer handling
findings.reproduction: Normalize an allowed Awin identifier longer than the generic 40-character limit.
findings.baseline_result: The identity was shortened rather than preserved.
findings.impact: Different products could lose identity consistency across validation and rendering.
findings.remediation: Preserve the provider-specific bounded valid identifier.
findings.verification: Long valid identifiers round-trip; invalid identifiers still reject.
findings.limitation: No live Awin listing or attribution verification performed.

findings.title: Sponsored selection used a different child-age parser
findings.reproduction: Use a natural-language child-age form recognized by backend validation in sponsored eligibility.
findings.baseline_result: The commercial parser could miss the age recognized by the recommendation parser.
findings.impact: Dormant placements could evaluate the same recipient differently.
findings.remediation: Reuse the shared age and exclusion parser for commercial eligibility.
findings.verification: Shared parsing and commercial gating regressions pass.
findings.limitation: Sponsored demos remain off and verified inventory remains empty.

findings.title: Single-strategy entropy returned NaN
findings.reproduction: Calculate normalized strategy entropy when only one strategy is observed.
findings.baseline_result: Division by log(1) produced NaN, serialized as null.
findings.impact: A reported quality metric was not finite or interpretable.
findings.remediation: Return zero diversity for one observed strategy.
findings.verification: Focused test and both historical offline replays pass.
findings.limitation: Correct arithmetic is not validation of the metric as a human-quality measure.

findings.title: Turnstile missing-configuration and challenge-context enforcement incomplete
findings.reproduction: Remove required verification configuration in an isolated deployment, or return a successful Siteverify fixture with a wrong hostname/action.
findings.baseline_result: Missing secret configuration could bypass verification; challenge context was not fully checked.
findings.impact: Misconfiguration or otherwise valid wrong-context tokens could weaken paid-request abuse protection.
findings.remediation: Require production configuration, fail ideas closed with 503, check hostname/action and HTTP success, label current browser/native widgets with the fixed ideas action, expose fixed diagnostic codes only.
findings.verification: Missing configuration, hostile context, replay, timeout, errors and client bypass flags reject; both widget sources exercise the fixed action in VM regressions.
findings.limitation: Legacy missing/empty action remains accepted; real production secret values and deployed remediation are not verified.

findings.title: Mutable workflow action tags and missing build gates
findings.reproduction: Inspect uses references and quality commands at the baseline commit.
findings.baseline_result: Third-party actions used movable version tags; generated page and bundle/build checks were absent.
findings.impact: Upstream tag movement or generated/build drift could bypass the existing quality gate.
findings.remediation: Pin verified full upstream commit SHAs; add timeout, generation drift, app bundle and Worker dry-run gates.
findings.verification: Source guardrails and equivalent local generation/build checks pass.
findings.limitation: The changed workflow has not run remotely; dependency-update ownership is still required.

findings.title: No main branch protection or repository rulesets
findings.reproduction: Read repository branch-protection, ruleset and deployment-environment metadata through the authenticated GitHub API.
findings.baseline_result: No configured main protection, rulesets or deployment environments were returned.
findings.impact: Available CI does not guarantee required reviews or passing checks before changes reach main.
findings.remediation: Operator should configure reviewed changes, required checks, restricted bypass and release environments.
findings.verification: Read-only account observation; no external settings changed.
findings.limitation: Repository plan and owner policy must be confirmed before choosing enforceable settings.

findings.title: Status and privacy copy contradicted implementation
findings.reproduction: Compare documented discovery/engine settings and no-name/list-limit claims with Wrangler and wishlist implementation.
findings.baseline_result: Enabled discovery was described as disabled; baseline/experimental roles and named local list limits were inconsistent.
findings.impact: Users and operators could rely on inaccurate functionality or data-handling descriptions.
findings.remediation: Correct active flags, baseline selection, historical exception, named-list capacity and cached-search qualifications.
findings.verification: Copy checks and repeatable generated-page build pass.
findings.limitation: Accurate technical copy is not a legal compliance determination.

findings.title: Corrupt wishlist recovery could overwrite original storage
findings.reproduction: Store a collection containing one valid gift and a malformed entry, reload, then attempt a save.
findings.baseline_result: Recovery could become an empty replacement and destroy previously recoverable bytes.
findings.impact: User-created local lists could be irreversibly lost.
findings.remediation: Preserve original bytes, expose safe recovered items, refuse destructive overwrite and report in-memory-only persistence.
findings.verification: Storage fixtures including 1,000 gifts pass; local browser preserved exact corrupt bytes and displayed the surviving item and warning.
findings.limitation: No cloud backup or recovery from OS/browser deletion is introduced.

findings.title: Swipe completion could act on a changed top card
findings.reproduction: Begin a drag, refresh or replace the top card, then release the old gesture.
findings.baseline_result: The completion could save or dismiss a different card.
findings.impact: User intent was applied to the wrong recommendation.
findings.remediation: Bind gesture to its originating card and cancel obsolete gestures on refresh/top-card change.
findings.verification: Changed-card and normal swipe cases pass.
findings.limitation: Physical touch/OS gesture testing remains outstanding.

findings.title: Stale shared-list decoding could overwrite a new finder flow
findings.reproduction: Delay shared-list decoding, start a new finder, then resolve or reject the old decode.
findings.baseline_result: Stale success or error could replace the current results/UI.
findings.impact: A new user action could be lost to an older asynchronous operation.
findings.remediation: Invalidate decode revisions at new finder and decoration boundaries.
findings.verification: Stale success and failure ignored; current decode still works.
findings.limitation: Not a complete long-duration memory or lifecycle soak test.

findings.title: Black Friday used fourth Friday rather than day after Thanksgiving
findings.reproduction: Generate the reminder in a year whose November starts on Friday, such as 2024.
findings.baseline_result: Fourth-Friday arithmetic selected 22 November rather than 29 November.
findings.impact: Exported shopping reminders could be scheduled a week early.
findings.remediation: Calculate the fourth Thursday plus one day.
findings.verification: 101 calendar years checked against the defining rule.
findings.limitation: Apple, Google and Outlook calendar imports were not performed.

findings.title: Compatibility-copy failure misreported primary save status
findings.reproduction: Allow primary wishlist setItem to succeed but fail the legacy compatibility-copy write.
findings.baseline_result: Overall save reporting did not accurately describe already-persisted data.
findings.impact: Users could retry or believe a successful primary save was lost.
findings.remediation: Separate primary persistence from compatibility-copy failure and surface a specific notice through callers.
findings.verification: Partial-write and fully unavailable storage cases pass.
findings.limitation: Storage errors remain possible and are reported rather than hidden.

findings.classification: Defence-in-depth; no exposed UI exploit established
findings.title: Optional calendar UID accepted line-control characters
findings.reproduction: Call the exported helper directly with a UID containing CR/LF.
findings.baseline_result: The optional argument could introduce additional calendar lines.
findings.impact: Future untrusted callers could corrupt event output; normal UI uses a generated UUID.
findings.remediation: Reject empty/non-string/control-character UIDs before encoding.
findings.verification: Malformed UID rejected and normal folded output preserved.
findings.limitation: No attacker-controlled production UID input was established.

findings.title: Upstream error bodies and arbitrary exception text were logged
findings.reproduction: Return an upstream non-2xx body or thrown error with a synthetic private-data marker; inspect captured diagnostics.
findings.baseline_result: Provider body/exception text could enter logs. New storage errors also required avoiding recovered payload logging.
findings.impact: If an upstream error includes request-derived data, log readers/retention can receive unnecessary sensitive content.
findings.remediation: Cancel unread upstream error bodies; log fixed local messages and validated numeric status/reason codes; omit recovered-list error objects.
findings.verification: Synthetic upstream markers absent from error logs; generic client errors and status diagnostics preserved.
findings.limitation: No actual credential leak, log compromise or provider-side log retention was established.

findings.title: Frontend eBay campaign empty while Worker campaign configured
findings.reproduction: Compare the public search-link campaign configuration with the Worker offer campaign configuration without visiting an affiliate destination.
findings.baseline_result: Search/fallback links are unmonetised while API offer links can carry the Worker campaign.
findings.impact: Attribution differs across user flows; lost commission cannot be quantified from configuration.
findings.remediation: Operator must confirm approval and intended tracking scope before aligning both surfaces.
findings.verification: Source divergence confirmed; no external activation or tracking change made.
findings.limitation: Account standing, payout and intended frontend enablement remain unverified.

findings.title: API27-only navigation attribute used in API24 base resources
findings.reproduction: Run Android lintDebug with the configured minimum API24.
findings.baseline_result: Lint fails NewApi for android:windowLightNavigationBar, introduced in API27.
findings.impact: Native quality gate fails and older systems cannot provide the requested dark navigation icons.
findings.remediation: Extract common theme; place cream navigation bar and dark-icon attribute in values-v27. API24-26 retain the platform navigation appearance.
findings.verification: assembleDebug, lintDebug and testDebugUnitTest pass; lint reports zero errors and 30 warnings after the individual Android warning review.
findings.limitation: No physical API24/API27 device verification; minimum SDK not raised and no lint suppression added.
